_about: The built-in screen of a MacBook Pro 16 (looks like 1512 x 982) and the bar's item widths, measured on the live bar on 2026-11-12 with Hack Nerd Font (sketchybar --query <item> bounding_rects). tests/notch-test.sh lays the bar out from these.
_fixed: Drawn width of an item without a label.
_overhead: Drawn width of a labelled item minus its label (characters x label_char_width).
_worst: The widest a day can draw them: the longest theme name, a Friday with the stand-up timer on, a long app and track name, both Claude limits at 100%.

worst.media: A very long track title that scrolls
